items.title: 26.4 Using Monomers to Predict the Type of Polymerisation

blocks.text: The monomer or pair of monomers can be used to predict the type of polymerisation: a C=C bond points to addition polymerisation, and two reactive functional groups that can form a linkage point to condensation polymerisation.

blocks.prompt: Predict the type of polymerisation for propene and for 6-aminohexanoic acid.
blocks.explanation: Propene (C=C): addition. 6-aminohexanoic acid (-NH2 and -COOH): condensation, giving a polyamide (nylon-6).

items: C=C: addition; two reactive groups: condensation.
